final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT circuitId AS c, COUNT(*) AS n FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c AS c, s1.n AS n, CAST(s1.n AS REAL) / s2.t AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s3) SELECT s3.c, s3.n, s3.r, s3.r - s4.a AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.r > s4.a ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 10
